defs.def: to move data to a smaller computer system from a larger one 下载；下装nounadj.

ex.s: Make sure to download your parking pass to your smartphone before arrival.
ex.t: 务必在到达前将停车证下载到你的智能手机上。

ex.s: So, if you're a sugar addict and aren't able to say no to chocolate or cola, you had better download it now!
ex.t: 所以，如果你是个糖瘾君子，无法对巧克力或可乐说不，你最好现在就下载它！

ex.s: It had a cafe selling organic food, and there were now more community events such as book readings, poetry recitals and even jazz concerts and movie nights, where people could gather to share an experience that couldn’t be downloaded.
ex.t: 那里有一家卖有机食品的咖啡馆，现在还有更多的社区活动，比如读书会、诗歌朗诵会，甚至爵士音乐会和电影之夜，人们可以聚在一起分享无法下载的体验。

ex.s: EXAMPLE I have downloaded that free app, but it doesn’t work well.→ The free app (which/that) I have downloaded doesn’t work well.
ex.t: 例子：我下载了那个免费应用，但它不好用。→ 我下载的那个免费应用不好用。

ex.s: We can download software, documents, and images whenever we need them.
ex.t: 我们可以随时下载软件、文档和图片。

ex.s: Examples from the text More examples you know access convenient surf inspire distance network download cash update benefit The Internet has brought great to Wuzhen, a small waterside town in Zhejiang Province.
ex.t: 文中的例子 你了解的更多例子 访问 方便 浏览 启发 距离 网络 下载 现金 更新 受益 互联网给乌镇——浙江省的一个水乡小镇——带来了巨大的便利。
